name: Kenya

latest_census.notes: 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census (August 2019; results released 4 Nov 2019). Religion: Volume IV 'Distribution of Population by Socio-Economic Characteristics' has 'Table 2.30 Distribution of Population by Religious Affiliation and County' (census.ke URL slug and openAFRICA resource title both name it). Ethnicity: asked -- national shares are published (Wikipedia 'Kenya' snippet: 'According to the 2019 census ... 17.13% Kikuyu; 14.35% Luhya; 13.37% Kalenjin; 10.65% Luo ...' across '46 tribes and ethnicities') and KNBS has an 'Ethnic Affiliation' page (https://www.knbs.or.ke/ethnic-affiliation/); whether an ethnicity-by-county table exists could not be confirmed from any snippet, and the checking searches ('open.africa ... ethnicity nationality county resource', 'ethnicity by county not published national only') were refused -- session search budget exhausted. Language: no result tied a language/mother-tongue question to the census questionnaire; a Statista title 'Primary languages spoken at home in Kenya 2019, by area' surfaced but its source is not shown and 'by area' suggests urban/rural, not counties. Treat language as unestablished. Kenya is NOT in the US Census Bureau subnational series (SOURCES.md line ~1353: 'Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda are not in the series at all').

wikipedia.admin2_level_note: The three samples all resolve to Constituency articles, so the boundary's 290 admin2 shapes are Kenya's 290 parliamentary constituencies. KNBS publishes by 'sub-county' (Volume I: 'Population by County and Sub-County'); sub-counties largely coincide with constituencies but are not identical, and no religion or ethnicity table below county surfaced at all.

tier_reason: A census count of religion by county, in a machine-readable openAFRICA resource whose title names the table, at 47 counties = admin1 exactly. Ethnicity by county is unconfirmed (the check was cut off by the search budget); nothing exists below county.
recommended_action: Fetch the openAFRICA 'Distribution of Population by Religious Affiliation and County' resource and join on county to admin1 -- it supersedes the Afrobarometer survey estimate for religion at 35 counties and should also fill the 12 counties the survey missed (check those 12 for name spelling, e.g. hyphenation like 'Taita-Taveta', 'Elgeyo-Marakwet', 'Tharaka-Nithi'). While there, list the other resources in the same openAFRICA dataset for an ethnicity-by-county table; if absent, check KNBS Volume IV's ethnicity table level before declaring ethnicity county-level not_published. Leave admin2 (constituencies) empty: Volume IV is by county only, and nothing by sub-county or constituency surfaced.

summary: Kenya's 2019 census asked religion and ethnicity; religion is published by county in Volume IV Table 2.30 and mirrored as a machine-readable resource on openAFRICA (and as an HTML table on census.ke), at 47 counties matching admin1 exactly. That count should replace the Afrobarometer survey estimate now filling 35 counties and fill the 12 the survey missed. Ethnicity is published nationally (46 groups) but whether Volume IV tabulates it by county could not be confirmed before the search budget ran out; language does not appear to have been asked. The 290 admin2 shapes are parliamentary constituencies, and no religion or ethnicity table exists below county.
